entries.name: Zach Charbonnet
entries.summary: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Friday that Charbonnet (knee) returning to practice next week is potentially "on the table," Corbin Smith of SI.com reports.

entries.name: Puka Nacua
entries.summary: Nacua (hip), who is listed as doubtful for Sunday's game at Denver, has been hampered by a groin injury that has impacted his explosiveness, and while the Rams haven't taken surgery "entirely off the table," the issue is considered "short term," with a return possible sooner rather than later, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Brock Bowers
entries.summary: Bowers (knee), who is listed as questionable for Week 3, is expected to make his season debut Sunday at New Orleans, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Colby Parkinson
entries.summary: Parkinson (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's contest at Denver, Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Keon Coleman
entries.summary: Coleman (ankle), who is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Chargers, is expected to play, Cameron Wolfe of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Marvin Mims Jr.
entries.summary: Mims (foot) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Rams, Zac Stevens of TheDNVR.com reports.

entries.name: Mike Evans
entries.summary: Evans (hip) remains listed as questionable for Sunday's game versus the Cardinals but intends to play, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Trey Lance
entries.summary: Lance was a limited participant in Friday's practice due to a groin injury and is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Bills.

entries.name: Tyson Bagent
entries.summary: Bagent (concussion) was a full participant in Saturday's practice but is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Eagles.

entries.name: Zay Flowers
entries.summary: Flowers (hamstring) will participate in a pregame workout to determine his status for Sunday's game against the Cowboys in Rio de Janeiro, but the Ravens don't appear as if they expect him to play, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Alec Pierce
entries.summary: Pierce (heel) was placed on injured reserve Saturday.

entries.name: Andrei Iosivas
entries.summary: The Bengals placed Iosivas (thumb) on injured reserve Saturday.

entries.name: Arian Smith
entries.summary: Smith (knee) underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn ACL and will miss the rest of the season, Antwan V. Staley of the New York Daily News reports.

entries.name: David Njoku
entries.summary: The Chargers placed Njoku (fibula) on injured reserve Wednesday.

entries.name: Demarcus Robinson
entries.summary: The 49ers placed Robinson (ankle) on injured reserve Saturday.

entries.name: Jaxson Dart
entries.summary: The Giants officially placed Dart (knee) on injured reserve Thursday, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Jonah Coleman
entries.summary: Coleman (ankle) is being placed on injured reserve Saturday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Jonathon Brooks
entries.summary: Brooks is expected to undergo surgery Wednesday to repair a core-muscle injury and is likely to miss at least six weeks, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Ronnie Rivers
entries.summary: The Rams placed Rivers (calf) on their injured reserve list Wednesday.
